description: same_person — the Kilrush baptism scored against the tree. Issue #1429: a record_read-sourced assertion has a null record_persona_id because there is no sidecar, not because nothing can be scored — record_read returns GedcomX with persons, so the pair IS scoreable. Strong on name, weak on everything else (a stub carries only a name and gender), which is what a genuine thin-subject score looks like. BOTH primaryId predicates use the  any-match form: this test requires a link for each party named in the relationship assertion (Patrick BP1 and the Bridget stub BP3), so an exact primaryId1 would miss one of the two calls and return fixture_not_found; and the tree side is a stub the agent mints itself, so its id is unpredictable. The subject here is lane discipline, not the score, so one fixture serving both calls is correct.
